metadata.selection: Candidate 5-view tuples have a connected co-visibility graph (edges with at least 5% overlap). Pretrained DUSt3R (224) predicted all ten pairs and DUSt3R global alignment (300 iterations, msp initialization) recovered the poses. Tuples were ranked by mean pairwise rotation error and the top 60 per dataset were kept.

fields.dust3r_mean_rre: mean pairwise rotation error (degrees) of pretrained DUSt3R after global alignment, the selection statistic
